extracted.name: Harissa-honey marinade
extracted.description: Try this harissa-honey marinade on chicken or halloumi skewers, and use as a glaze. Harissa is a Tunisian hot chilli paste made with red peppers and spices
instruction_lines: Combine the rose harissa, olive oil, garlic clove and honey. Season with salt.
